items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: And Lips Page was the Master of Ceremonies. And he would introduce the stars that would come in.

ctx.x: Head arrangements. And I just went crazy listening to that band. And I went back every night until I got to know Lester and Bas’ and I established contact with Basie because when I heard he was from Red Bank, New Jersey I said, “I’m from Plainfield, New Jersey.” “Hey man!” And he had an ashtray you know that had little roaches on it, you know that are well spent marijuana. Just that little bit. They’d save them and grind them up and do them again. But drinking was open. And they started a little bit earlier, but…
Was the atmosphere, was it semi-segregated?
